newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar gains ground after NY stops hit.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar gains ground after NY stops hit.

text.p: White sugar futures perked up on Wednesday afternoon as July raws stops were triggered but most of the day's activity was confined to spread trading of nearby August/October, traders said.
Fund buying pushed July raws up 25 points to hit a high of 11.37 cents/lb, boosting sentiment in London and putting steam behind the spot August whites contract.

Nearby values all gained ground as August firmed, with August/October widening further after broker spread buying had dominated the session earlier and countered Paris-based pre-hedge selling against the EU tender.
At 1530 GMT August was up $3.30 at $314.20, through its initial resistance point of $312.50, but 30 cents off its intraday high as profits were taken.
Technical analysts pegged the next resistance at $316.50 but noted that the 14-day relative strength index was fast approaching the 70-value overbought buffer.
October was up $1.60 at $306.50 and overall volume reached a hefty 2,641 lots, mostly in August. Traders said much of this had come from crosses on the spread and also outright crosses on October.
In Paris volume reached 463 lots, with August up $2.70 at $313.70 and October unchanged at $305.00.
